title: Download redirect test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/download-redirects/cases.json (docs/installation-plan.md rule 10; source_url_prefixes and redirect_hosts of registry/plan-step-kinds.json). Each case gives the step kind, the requested URL (step.source.url) and the redirect targets the server answered with, in order, as absolute URLs (the last one is the final URL; an empty array means no redirect). response_bytes, when given, is the length of the response body of the final URL. expected=allowed: the response body of the final URL may be downloaded (its SHA-256 is still checked). expected=refused: nothing is downloaded and the step fails with reason_code (failure class source_unavailable).
